note: What a scan must hand the administrator. Produced on the device or the mounted drive, never by this repository reaching outward. Two doors produce it: a folder (path is identity) and the Photos library (asset_id is identity). A record has one or the other, never neither.

path.note: relative to the scanned root; for a photos record, a synthetic photos://<album>/<name>

ext.note: lowercased, no dot; empty string is legal

content_hash.note: sha256 hex. Absent is legal and degrades duplicate to candidate — it never fabricates one.

asset_id.note: Photos door only, and it is the identity there. The SAME asset_id seen under several albums is one file listed several times — see mfile/doors.json, first rule. Collapsing them is not optional.

album.note: Photos door only. One per listing; the administrator gathers them into `albums` when it collapses.

captured_at.note: ISO 8601. Photos door only, and where present it is the date a version series is ordered by — mtime is when the file was last written, which after a copy or a sync is not when the thing was made.
